Overview

Violentine (Brutal Angel) is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. She can only be obtained by evolving Violentine

Evolving

Violentine (Brutal Angel) can be evolved from Violentine with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Twisted Love

Summon the last dead enemy damaged by Violentine (Brutal Angel) with 25% of their original health every 5 attacks. (Global Limit of 10 summons at once).

This passive is also called Resurrection Dance, which unlocks at Upgrade 1.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • The summons can be buffed by Zombie (Risen) passive, as well with Griffin (Ascension), Commander and Idol (Star) buffs
